title: Perform Your Art
description: You express yourself and affect others with a particular artistic skill: __brd1a__(Is it cooking, music, poetry, or something else?). When you perform your art for an audience, roll+CHA.

bullets: Affect — An audience member clears a marked Condition
Connect — A PC audience member marks 1 Depth with you
Craft — Regain one use of **artistic samples** (see below)
Dazzle — An NPC audience member gives you a gift or tries to meet you privately (their call)

outcomes.text: You feel the performance was awful; choose one below, but mark a Condition.

submoves.title: Note
submoves.description: An option chosen more than once must apply to a new audience member.
